project.name: inference-embedded-core
project.description:
Shared core for the embedded variants (E-Sync, E-Async). Contains the ONNX-Runtime-backed SentimentClassifier implementation, the CardiffNLP text preprocessor, and the fault-injection decorator. The sync and async variant modules depend on this core and add only their dispatch layer and Spring wiring.
This module is a compile-time library shared between two variant modules. At runtime it does not constitute a deployment unit of its own — both embedded variants ship as a single Spring Boot fat jar, preserving the modular monolith property.
